credential_contract_summary.account_source: oldko.accounts via exact pinned WS07 PgWs13AccountRepository

username.accepted: 4-20 ASCII bytes; first character letter; remaining letters/digits/underscore

password_write.accepted: 10-12 printable ASCII bytes U+0021-U+007E with at least three character classes

legacy_transition.web_login: verify the exact stored legacy password value; successful incompatible credential returns credentialUpgradeRequired=true
legacy_transition.game_access_check: correct but non-KO1298-compatible legacy credential is rejected with CREDENTIAL_UPGRADE_REQUIRED
legacy_transition.password_change: exact legacy current password may authenticate; replacement must satisfy the shared KO1298-compatible write policy
legacy_transition.password_reset: replacement must satisfy the shared KO1298-compatible write policy
legacy_transition.old_password_after_rotation: rejected by the shared WS07 scrypt verifier
legacy_transition.already_authenticated_game_session_disco: WS03 runtime ownership; no WS13 wire/protocol widening

api_contract_summary.trusted_origin: https://oldkoweb.com required for browser mutation routes
api_contract_summary.readiness: GET /readyz; PostgreSQL account repository plus PostgreSQL shared rate-limit store

delivery_contract_summary.transport: signed HTTPS JSON webhook using HMAC-SHA256 timestamp.body
delivery_contract_summary.sender_requirement: sender must be on verified oldkoweb.com domain
delivery_contract_summary.token_transport: signed HTTPS JSON body only; never logged and never embedded by WS13 in public URL artifacts

checks.name: postgres-integration
verified: register plus WS07 game hash verification
password change and previous session invalidation
password reset and previous credential rejection
12-byte KO1298-compatible password accepted by game access-check
unsupported reset password does not consume token

ci.note: CI capture/sink proves the signed receiver contract and provider-ACK semantics only; it is not production mail-delivery evidence.

production_dependencies.repository: exact WS07 PgWs13AccountRepository; production memory fallback prohibited

items: Provision persistent DATABASE_URL and deploy the exact pinned WS07 account repository module; do not substitute a memory repository.
Apply pinned WS07 account migrations, then services/account-api/sql/0001_postgres_rate_limit.sql in the coordinated migration order.
Reverse-proxy https://oldkoweb.com/api/account to this long-running service and set OLDKO_ACCOUNT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://oldkoweb.com plus explicit OLDKO_TRUST_PROXY.
Provision OLDKO_ACCOUNT_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_URL, OLDKO_ACCOUNT_DELIVERY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and OLDKO_ACCOUNT_MAIL_FROM without requesting them individually from the user.
Verify the oldkoweb.com sender/domain with the selected real mail provider, including provider-required SPF/DKIM records.
Run a controlled provider-acceptance smoke and record provider plus provider_message_id without recording verification/reset tokens.
Consume services/account-api/contracts/credential-policy.v1.json and align register/change/reset client validation/messages to exact 10-12 printable ASCII bytes.
Handle credentialUpgradeRequired=true after legacy web login by directing the account to change/reset before game login.
Preserve the pinned /v1/accounts/password/... body-token route contract; do not move reset/verification tokens into insecure URL logging flows.
Using a controlled real/sandbox recipient, verify actual verification-mail and password-reset-mail receipt separately from WS09 provider acceptance.
Keep KO1298 20-byte username and 12-byte password packet limits unchanged.
Consume the shared oldko.accounts hash for subsequent game authentication.

If immediate disconnect of already-authenticated game sessions after password rotation is required, implement it in the game runtime; WS13 already invalidates web sessions and rotates the shared hash/passwordVersion.
No competing account schema is introduced by WS13; retain the pinned shared account/session/action-token schema and adapter.
Keep the WS13 service-owned account_rate_limits migration coordinated with the shared migration plan.
